FN-XDSD5E7-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 111
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/08/2025
Senate Bill 111 as introduced would appropriate $133,000,000 from the Educational
Opportunities Reserve Fund (EORF) for fiscal year 2025 to the following entities to be used
pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
1) State Department of Education $100,000,000
2) Alabama Department of Workforce $18,000,000
3) Higher Education Research Institutions $15,000,000
Page 1

FN-XDSD5E7-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 111
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/10/2025
Senate Bill 111 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education would
appropriate $375,000,000 from the Educational Opportunities Reserve Fund (EORF) for fiscal
year 2025 to the Renewing Alabama's Investment in Student Excellence (RAISE) Fund. The
provisions of this bill would only be effective upon enactment of HB 533 or SB 305 of the 2025
Regular Session.
Page 1

FN-XDSD5E7-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 111
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/21/2025
Senate Bill 111 as passed the Senate would transfer $375 million from the Educational
Opportunities Reserve Fund to the Renewing Alabama's Investment in Student Excellence Fund
during the 2025 fiscal year. The provisions of this bill would only be effective upon enactment
of House Bill 533 or Senate Bill 305 of the 2025 Regular Session.
Page 1

FN-XDSD5E7-4
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 111
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/22/2025
Senate Bill 111 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education would make the
following transfers from the Educational Opportunities Reserve Fund during the 2025 fiscal
year:
(1) $375 million to the Renewing Alabama's Investment in Student Excellence (RAISE) Fund;
and
(2) $80 million to the Creating Hope and Opportunity for Our Students' Education Act Fund.
The provisions of this bill for the transfer to the RAISE Fund would only be effective upon
enactment of House Bill 533 or Senate Bill 305 of the 2025 Regular Session.
